requirements.source_summary: Isolation valve provision for each gas appliance.
Civil Defense notification/coordination across project stages including before operation.
Gas-system piping is pressure-tested before operation.
Suitable alarm/fire-extinguishing provisions are available near the gas installation.
Safety warning signage is installed around the gas area.
Where the modeled use case requires it, gas-leak detection automatically cuts gas supply.
